summary: Shimmick Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that on October 2, 2026, its subsidiary Shimmick Construction Company, Inc. entered into a $14.3 million Loan and Security Agreement with Sixty-First Commercial Finance, LLC, evidenced by a promissory note maturing October 2, 2031, bearing 9.31% interest, with a 15% default rate. Proceeds fund project expenses and general corporate purposes. The borrower granted a security interest in equipment and related intangibles, with the Company and a subsidiary providing guaranties. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation.
